item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Not bad for $59,000! C. 1922 in Virginia.
item.description: This fixer upper has some nice potential! Especially at that price. Could live there and work room by room. The house was built in 1922. It is located on .46 acre in Clifton Forge, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, wood floors, baseboards, basement, sunroom and a decent sized kitchen. item.title: A lot of house for the money! Love the sunroom! 6,000 square feet in Ohio. $625,000
item.description: This sure is a lot of house for the money! I am in love with that sunroom! The house was built in 1928. It is located on 1.22 acres in Akron, Ohio. The house features a grand foyer, pretty staircase, wood floors, custom drapes, baseboards, crown moulding, beautiful sunroom with vintage chandelier, really spacious kitchen, wainscoting, office with built-in bookshelves and a finished basement. item.description: The pool looks nice! This mid-century has nice details! The house was built in 1953. It is located on 1.12 acres in Lawton, Oklahoma. item.title: Beautiful yard! Beautiful house! Over an acre in North Carolina. $510,000
item.description: This sure has a beautiful yard! Pretty pool! The house is nice too. The home was built in 1940. It is located on 1.27 acres in Mount Olive, North Carolina. The house features two covered porches, wood floors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, large butler’s pantry, chair rails, built-in shelving, updated kitchen and a large basement. item.title: Pretty interior! Over two acres in Virginia. $319,000
item.description: Pretty interior and a pretty setting! This is the Sears Kit Van Jean Model home. The house was built in 1930. It is located on 2.28 acres in Montross, Virginia. The house features pretty wood floors, knotty pine room, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves, a lot of natural light and a basement. There is a detached garage, fenced in area and a large patio. item.title: The Beam House. C. 1878 in Oregon. $279,000
item.description: This has some nice details inside! It is known as the Beam House. It was built in 1878. It is located in Albany, Oregon. The house features wood floors, picture rails, baseboards, pretty chandelier, pocket doors, stained glass, built-in corner cabinet and wainscoting. Five bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,976 square feet. $279,000 Contact Anne Fahy with Cascade Hasson Sotheby’s International Realty: 541-760-5691 From the Zillow listing: Circa 1878 (County says 1900), and your chance to own a delight

item.title: Pretty stained glass! C. 1888 in Pennsylvania. $149,900
item.description: This house has nice details! Pretty stained glass! the house was built in 1888. It is located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The house features a covered front porch, small upper porch, unpainted millwork, wide baseboards, leaded glass, transom windows, stained glass and a spacious kitchen. Would love to see what is underneath all of the carpeting. item.title: Mississippi’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1836. $4,800,000
item.description: Welcome to Mississippi’s most expensive old house listing! Known as the Purser-Brunt Home. It was built in 1836. It is located on .96 acre in Oxford, Mississippi. The house features wood floors, wainscoting, transom windows, crown moulding, chair rails and original mantels. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Eight bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,979 square feet. $4,800,000 From the Zillow listing: An extremely rare opportunity to purchase the historic 1836 Purser-Brunt home awaits. L

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! The Benson House, C. 1812 in South Carolina. $250,000
item.description: Diamond in the rough! A lot of history with this house! The home was built in 1812. It is located on .32 acre in Pendleton, South Carolina. Work was started on this home and it’s waiting for someone to complete it. Once home to Enoch B. Benson, he was the town’s first mayor. Make sure you read the realtor’s write up for the complete history. There is a large covered front porch, wood floors, french doors and a lot of knotty pine. This is a big house! item.description: Porch goals! There are original details inside! The house was built in 1907. It is located on one acre in New Tazewell, Tennessee. The price seems a bit high to me. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, picture rails, spacious kitchen and transom windows.
